description: Read any public bettrails.com page as clean text and tables; its links (shown as [/path]) can be read too. eSoccer players, head-to-heads, today's matches and results (/hoy, /resultados), ELO ranking (/jugadores), /records; esports and basketball sections /lol, /dota, /cs2, /valorant, /basket (today, leagues, teams, players, matches with preview or result, tournaments, champions, heroes, agents, maps, countries, records). Starting points: /hoy, /lol/hoy, /dota/hoy, /cs2/hoy, /valorant/hoy, /basket/hoy, /lol/worlds. Find specific pages with search. Statistics only (no odds, no betting).

language.description: Language of the returned bettrails.com links (usually the conversation language). Default: es.

path.description: Page path or bettrails.com URL, e.g. "/valorant/hoy".

name: read_page
title: Read a Bettrails page
